# Tabler local assets

Pinned package: `@tabler/core@1.7.4` (MIT).

Upstream release: https://github.com/tabler/tabler/releases/tag/%40tabler%2Fcore%401.7.4

Files are served locally so the admin panel does not require a CDN at runtime:

- `tabler.min.css`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.7.4/dist/css/tabler.min.css
- `tabler.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.7.4/dist/js/tabler.min.js
- `LICENSE`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tabler/tabler/85e7da0/LICENSE

Application styling lives in `public/css/admin.css`. No Composer or NPM package was installed for this integration.
